actors.name: PTA subcommittee for the winter fair
actors.private_context: The subcommittee is responsible for organizing the winter fair. It needs to recruit four stall coordinators to manage the stalls at the fair. The subcommittee has not yet recruited any stall coordinators as of the start time. It plans to hold an October planning meeting where recruitment may be discussed.

shared_context: The PTA subcommittee for the winter fair is seeking four stall coordinators. The October planning meeting is scheduled to occur before the hard cutoff. The subcommittee can recruit coordinators through various means (e.g., announcements, personal outreach) before or during the meeting.

starting_events.description: The PTA subcommittee for the winter fair has not yet recruited any stall coordinators. The subcommittee is aware of the need to recruit four stall coordinators.
visible_to: PTA subcommittee for the winter fair

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the PTA subcommittee for the winter fair has recruited four stall coordinators at or before the October planning meeting (i.e., by the end of that meeting, which occurs before the hard cutoff). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
